body.x: OneCup (CEO Sophie Choi) announced its participation in CES 2025, which will occur from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas, USA, at the K-Startup Pavilion.

OneCup was founded to tokenize all existing assets to create an accessible environment where anyone can continuously invest and generate financial returns. From its inception, the company has focused on developing, building, and operating its proprietary services while forming strategic alliances with leading firms across the U.S., Europe, and Asia, positioning itself as a global investment platform.

Aligned with this vision, OneCup launched OneCup Pro, a real estate fractional investment platform designed to lower the barriers to entry for younger investors. These investors often face challenges due to the high costs associated with real estate. This next-generation platform has garnered significant attention for making property investment more accessible.

At CES 2025, OneCup plans to showcase OneCup Pro, its groundbreaking investment platform and real estate tokenized securities issuance service, to attract investors from diverse global markets and demographics to its platform.

OneCup Pro utilizes blockchain technology to convert real estate into digital assets, enabling reliable and credible valuation and fractionalization. The platform’s core features allow investors to own legitimate real estate shares and securely participate in development, sales, and rental activities.

The platform incorporates a multimodal AI-based AVM (Automated Valuation Model) for property valuation. This system predicts specific real estate assets' current and future values by leveraging public, customer, and asset data. The automated valuation system also analyzes user-specific investment preferences and recommends tailored investment opportunities, enhancing the safety and profitability of investments.

A OneCup representative highlighted that OneCup Pro goes beyond traditional private real estate fractional investment functions. It advances projects like urban regeneration and ESG-linked investments by converting them into real-world assets (RWA). The company believes its technology and services can promote the democratization of socially impactful investments while supporting individual financial returns on a global scale.

The representative added, “Although we are not yet fully globalized, OneCup Pro has already collaborated with companies from various countries. Through CES 2025, we aim to showcase the platform and expand our international footprint. After the event, we plan to launch mobile and web services in regions like Singapore, the U.S., and the EU, creating a globally connected network for real estate fractional investments.”

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
